definitions.gloss: sunlight, rays of the sun, sunshine
definitions.explanation: Refers to the light or rays coming directly from the sun, often with an emphasis on warmth or brightness.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}い{陽射|ひざ}しが{窓|まど}から{入|はい}ってきた。
examples.english: Strong sunlight came in through the window.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}の{陽射|ひざ}しが{心地|ここち}よい。
{陽射|ひざ}しを{避|さ}けて{木陰|こかげ}で{休|やす}んだ。
examples.english: I rested in the shade, avoiding the sunlight.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{陽射|ひざ}しが{強|つよ}い (the sunlight is strong)
・{陽射|ひざ}しを{浴|あ}びる (to bask in the sunlight)
・{陽射|ひざ}しが{差|さ}す (sunlight shines in)

KANJI NOTE: Can also be written as 日差し with different kanji but same meaning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{日光|にっこう} - sunlight (more formal/scientific)
・{太陽|たいよう}の{光|ひかり} - light of the sun
